instructions.name: initialize
instructions.title: Initialize stake account
instructions.rationale: Sets the staker, withdrawer and lockup of a funded stake account, so the caller-chosen withdrawer controls the funds. No authority signature required.
instructions.notes: No authority signs, so anyone can initialize a funded, uninitialized stake account; the real exposure is the System create_account or transfer that funds it, so cap that spend. initialize_checked cannot set a lockup and needs the withdrawer to sign.

instructions.name: authorize
instructions.title: Authorize new stake or withdraw authority
instructions.rationale: Hands the staker or withdrawer authority to a caller-chosen key, transferring control of the stake account and its funds.
instructions.notes: The staker or the withdrawer may change the staker key; only the withdrawer may change the withdrawer key, plus the lockup custodian while a lockup is in force.

instructions.name: delegate_stake
instructions.title: Delegate stake to a validator
instructions.rationale: Delegates all lamports above the rent reserve to a caller-chosen vote account; staker signs. Moves no value out of owner control.
instructions.notes: Needs only the staker authority, which can be held separately from the withdrawer. Active stake cannot be re-delegated to another validator (TooSoonToRedelegate).

instructions.name: split
instructions.title: Split stake account
instructions.rationale: Moves lamports and delegation into a new uninitialized stake account that inherits the same authorities and lockup; staker signs.
instructions.notes: The destination must be a pre-allocated 200-byte uninitialized stake account; it inherits the source's authorities, so control stays with the owner. Splitting the full balance closes the source. Raw data is a u32 tag then a u64 lamports amount (12 bytes); report the zero-padded disc8, never the first 8 raw bytes.

instructions.name: withdraw
instructions.title: Withdraw from stake account
instructions.rationale: Sends lamports from a stake account to a caller-chosen recipient; withdrawer signs. Withdrawing the full balance closes the account.
instructions.notes: Needs the withdrawer authority; a lockup in force blocks it unless the lockup custodian also signs. Full-balance withdrawal is allowed only when no stake is active and sends the rent to the recipient. Raw data is a u32 tag then a u64 lamports amount (12 bytes); report the zero-padded disc8, never the first 8 raw bytes.

instructions.name: deactivate
instructions.title: Deactivate stake
instructions.rationale: Starts cooldown of the delegated stake so it can later be withdrawn; staker signs. Moves no value.

instructions.name: set_lockup
instructions.title: Set stake lockup
instructions.rationale: Changes lockup timestamp, epoch and custodian; can freeze withdrawals or install a custodian who can bypass or alter the lock.
instructions.notes: The withdrawer signs when no lockup is in force; the current custodian signs while one is. Each field is optional.

instructions.name: merge
instructions.title: Merge stake accounts
instructions.rationale: Merges a source stake account into a destination with identical authorities; the source is drained and closed. Staker signs.
instructions.notes: Both accounts must have equal staker and withdrawer keys and compatible lockups, so value stays under the same owner.

instructions.name: authorize_with_seed
instructions.title: Authorize new authority (seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Hands the staker or withdrawer authority to a caller-chosen key; the current authority is a seed-derived address proven by its base key.
instructions.notes: The base key signs and the program derives the current authority with create_with_seed. A lockup custodian must also sign when changing the withdrawer under an active lockup.

instructions.name: initialize_checked
instructions.title: Initialize stake account (checked)
instructions.rationale: Sets staker and withdrawer of a funded stake account with no lockup; the withdrawer must sign. The signing withdrawer controls the funds.
instructions.notes: Safer than initialize against typos, but not against a rogue caller who signs with its own key. Allow it explicitly for new-stake-account flows.

instructions.name: authorize_checked
instructions.title: Authorize new authority (checked)
instructions.rationale: Hands the staker or withdrawer authority to a key that must co-sign; still transfers control of the stake account and its funds.
instructions.notes: The current authority and the new authority both sign; a lockup custodian must also sign when changing the withdrawer under an active lockup.

instructions.name: authorize_checked_with_seed
instructions.title: Authorize new authority (checked, seed-derived)
instructions.rationale: Hands the staker or withdrawer authority to a co-signing key; the current authority is a seed-derived address proven by its base key.

instructions.name: set_lockup_checked
instructions.title: Set stake lockup (checked)
instructions.rationale: Changes lockup timestamp and epoch and may install a co-signing custodian; can freeze withdrawals or add a lock-bypass custodian.
instructions.notes: The withdrawer signs when no lockup is in force; the current custodian signs while one is. A new custodian, if given, must also sign.

instructions.name: get_minimum_delegation
instructions.title: Get minimum delegation
instructions.rationale: Returns the minimum stake delegation as little-endian u64 return data; takes no accounts and changes no state.
instructions.notes: The only stake instruction that still works while EpochRewards.active; every other instruction then fails with EpochRewardsActive.

instructions.name: deactivate_delinquent
instructions.title: Deactivate delinquent stake
instructions.rationale: Deactivates stake delegated to a long-delinquent validator; callable by anyone with no signer, and no value moves.
instructions.notes: Requires the delegated vote account to be delinquent for the minimum number of epochs and a reference vote account that voted recently.

instructions.name: redelegate
instructions.title: Redelegate (disabled)
instructions.rationale: Disabled: the program rejects this tag with InvalidInstructionData. Present only to preserve enum numbering; never needed in a mandate.
instructions.notes: Deprecated since interface 2.1.0 ("Redelegate will not be enabled"). program@v5.1.0, the release named in the on-chain binary's security.txt, returns InvalidInstructionData for it. Absent from idl.json; tag 15 appears only in interface-idl.json. Default-denied: no legitimate use.

instructions.name: move_stake
instructions.title: Move stake between accounts
instructions.rationale: Moves active stake between two stake accounts with identical authorities and lockups; staker signs. Value stays under the same owner.
instructions.notes: The source must be fully active and keep the minimum delegation unless all stake moves. Raw data is a u32 tag then a u64 lamports amount (12 bytes); report the zero-padded disc8, never the first 8 raw bytes.

instructions.name: move_lamports
instructions.title: Move unstaked lamports between accounts
instructions.rationale: Moves free, unstaked lamports between two stake accounts with identical authorities and lockups; staker signs. Value stays under the same owner.
instructions.notes: Rent-exempt reserve and delegated lamports cannot be moved. Raw data is a u32 tag then a u64 lamports amount (12 bytes); report the zero-padded disc8, never the first 8 raw bytes.
